project_type: Monorepo: Laravel 11 backend (PHP 8.2, Sanctum auth, MySQL in Docker prod / SQLite in tests) + Next.js 14 app-router frontend (TypeScript, Tailwind, lucide-react icons).
build_system: Composer (backend) + npm/next (frontend). Backend lives in backend/ (run commands from there); frontend package.json is at repo root. Backend runs in Docker container lms-backend in production.
test_framework: PHPUnit 11 (backend, tests use RefreshDatabase + Laravel\Sanctum Sanctum::actingAs). No frontend test framework.
build_command: Frontend: `npm run build` from repo root. Backend has no compile step — `php -l <file>` for syntax.
test_command: Backend: `php artisan test` (or `composer test`) from backend/. Migrations: `php artisan migrate` from backend/.
verification_instructions: Backend: run `php -l <path>` on each new/modified PHP file for syntax; run `php artisan migrate` to confirm migrations apply idempotently; run `php artisan test` to confirm no regression in the existing suite (do NOT expect new tests unless you add them). Frontend: run `npm run build` (type-checks + compiles all pages) and `npm run lint` from repo root; both must be clean.
environment_constraints: Windows host, PowerShell (use ';' not '&&' to chain commands). Production is a Docker container (lms-backend) — never restart the prod server. ENUM ALTER statements are MySQL/MariaDB-only and MUST be guarded by a supportsAlterModify() helper that checks DB::connection()->getDriverName() in ['mysql','mariadb']; the test suite uses SQLite and silently skips the ALTER, which is fine.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow existing code conventions: anonymous-class migrations with idempotency guards; SystemSetting uses Cache::rememberForever getters + updateOrCreate/Cache::forever setters with try/catch fail-safes; controllers extend App\Http\Controllers\Controller and return response()->json(['success'=>true,...]); routes grouped by role via Route::middleware('role:...')->group(...). Never change RoleMiddleware (handles multi-role via in_array already) or existing AttendanceController logic.
key_patterns: Migrations: `private function supportsAlterModify(): bool { return in_array(DB::connection()->getDriverName(), ['mysql','mariadb'], true); }`; guard ENUM ALTER with `if ($this->supportsAlterModify() && Schema::hasColumn($table,$col))`; guard column adds with `if (!Schema::hasColumn($table,$col))`. Models: protected $fillable array + protected function casts(): array returning ['col'=>'type']; belongsTo/hasMany relations; role helpers isAdmin()/isGuru()/isSiswa() (add isStaff() alongside). SystemSetting: `public const X_KEY='...'`; getter `Cache::rememberForever(self::cacheKey(KEY), fn() => try{...}catch{fail-safe default})`; setter `self::updateOrCreate(['setting_key'=>KEY],['setting_value'=>val]); Cache::forever(...)`. Controller: `$request->validate([...])`; `$request->user()`; private getRealClientIp(Request) reads X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP when request IP is private; returns JSON with 'success' bool. Frontend api.ts: named exports `export const xxxAPI = {...}` using shared `api` axios instance; pages are 'use client' default exports wrapped in <DashboardLayout>; UI from '@/components/ui' (Card, CardHeader, Button); device_id from localStorage (btoa([userAgent,language,screen,timezoneOffset].join('|')).slice(0,32)).
directory_structure: backend/ = Laravel app (app/Models, app/Http/Controllers/Api, routes/api.php, database/migrations, tests/Feature + tests/Unit). src/ = Next.js app router (src/app/<route>/page.tsx; src/app/admin/* for admin pages). src/services/api.ts = single axios-based API client with named exports. src/components/layouts/DashboardLayout.tsx = sidebar nav (navigation: NavItem[] with roles: string[]). src/components/ui = shared Card/Button primitives.
